notes.title: RKR - Rush, Kill, RELEASED!
notes.content:
After a couple of years of sitting dormant on an old hard drive, this old game-jam project of mine is finally getting its own Steam release!

For less than two dollars, you can nab yourself a copy!

Take a look at the trailer here:
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=lDKP0yzyFB8

If you'd like to join the Discord community, feel free to do so and ask questions, suggest features, and overall get involved in this new community!

https://discord.com/invite/2zch5Dv
